description: Put a FIT file on an athlete's plan, as dropping it on the app's calendar does: it is read, priced in TSS from their thresholds, matched onto the session planned for that day (or added as an extra), and its recording kept so get_session_analysis and grade_session work on it. FIT only, as base64.

athlete_id.description: May be omitted when you coach exactly one athlete.

name: upload_activity_file
